content: CORRECTION to initial digest: SPX and SPXW are broad-based index options and are IRC Section 1256 contracts, not standard equity options. Section 1256 contracts get marked-to-market at year-end, automatic 60/40 long/short capital-gain treatment regardless of holding period, and are reported on Form 6781 (feeding Schedule D), NOT Form 8949. Form 8949 is for regular (non-1256) securities. A journal exporting SPX/SPXW realized gains in an 8949 shape would produce a wrong tax form. Source: terms.law, legalclarity.org, optionsdecay.com, cboe.com/index-options-benefits-tax-treatment (search-summarised, consistent across independent sources, but not a fetched primary page -- treat the 1256/6781 conclusion as MEDIUM and verify against a CPA or the actual 1099-B before building a tax export feature).
